levicol3 posted a thesis on $CATE: Markets were absolutely insane for two months, and right now it feels like we’re in the cooldown before the real storm arrives.

New pairs have become incredibly difficult to trade, strong floors are forming on conviction plays, and majors have been bleeding from their local highs.

In my opinion, the last three months were just a warmup for what we’re about to witness.

Think about what we just experienced. We had multiple nine-figure runners for the first time in years. More activity in the trenches than we’ve seen in forever. New people entering the space, money flowing everywhere, and the overall vibes were incredible.

It almost felt too good to be true. And in hindsight, maybe it was, at least for the short term.

But I genuinely believe the best is still ahead of us.

Right now it feels like the entire market is sitting on its hands, waiting for majors to start moving higher again and confirm the bull run everyone has been anticipating.

My guess? When that confirmation comes, things are going to get absolutely ridiculous.

Now, as for CATE, I have genuinely never been more bullish.

Short-term price action means absolutely nothing to me compared to what we’ve built over the last two and a half months.

Think about where we started and where we are today.

We’ve survived multiple massive drawdowns, watched countless narratives come and go, and endured one of the bloodiest stretches the market has seen in months.

And somehow, through all of it, our community has only gotten stronger.

That’s what people are missing.

The normies we onboarded months ago are no longer the same people who panic sold every red candle. They’re becoming battle tested. They’re learning that volatility is part of crypto, that conviction takes patience, and that building something worth billions doesn’t happen overnight.

Every consolidation period is another opportunity for our holders to mature and our foundation to strengthen.

You cannot microwav
